Country: India
Official Website: https://maya.edu.in

Description:
Maya Devi University is a multidisciplinary university located in Dehradun, India, offering undergraduate, postgraduate, diploma, and doctoral programs across engineering, health sciences, pharmacy, management, arts, sciences, and vocational studies. Its origins go back to Maya Group of Colleges (established 2010); it was constituted as a university under the Uttarakhand Private University (Amendment) Act 2024 (Act No. 05, 2024).
